title: Are consent signals in the TC String created after affirmative action by the user?
If a 'Reject All' option is provided in the UI, when the user clicks it, are all consent signals for purposes and vendors set to 'off'?
Does the CMP update the applicable IABTCF_* values after a change of users' choices made in the CMP UI?
Did the CMP store pre-parsed TC data as well as the TC String using the structure defined by the technical specifications?
Is the CMP registered?
note: CMP registration is a business fact, not something the SDK can test.

title: Is the GVL version format correct?
Is the current or penultimate version of the GVL being used?
Is the max Vendor ID less than or equal to the highest ID in the GVL?
Are purposes 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 set to 'no' for legitimate interest? (optional)
Do the Created and LastUpdated fields have the same value?
Are the Created and LastUpdated timestamps imprecise?
Are all vendor signals for deleted vendors set to 0?
Does the TC String include the disclosedVendors segment? (optional)
Is the UI prominently displayed, covering most of the website content?
Is the UI displayed separately from other information such as terms and conditions or the privacy policy?
Does the 1st layer provide information about the storage and access of information from the user's device by the publisher and third-party vendors?
Does the 1st layer provide information about the processing of personal data by the publisher and third-party vendors?
Does the 1st layer provide an example of personal data processed?
Is there a direct link to the list of third parties in the 1st layer?
Does the 1st layer provide information about the Purposes and/or Stacks and Special Features used by third parties?
Does the 1st layer provide information about the scope of the consent choice (service-specific or group-specific)?
Does the 1st layer inform the user that they can withdraw consent at any time and how to do so?
Are there calls to action in the 1st layer to express consent (e.g. "Accept") and customise choices (e.g. "Manage options")?
Do the two primary calls to action on the 1st layer have matching text treatment (font, size, style) and each a minimum 5:1 contrast ratio?
Does the 1st layer show the number of third-party Vendors?
If the 1st layer uses modified Stack descriptions, is the UseNonStandardTexts flag set to 1?
Does the UI show Purposes and Features with their standard names or Stacks, and wherever Features are shown, their standard explanations and no user controls? (optional)
Can users review the standard user-friendly texts and illustrations for Purposes and Features?
If the UI includes non-TCF Vendors, are they presented separately?
Does the UI provide information about third-party Vendors processing personal data based on legitimate interest (if any)?
Does the UI advise the user of their right to object to processing based on legitimate interest (if any)?
Can the user review the list of Vendors, their Purposes, Special Purposes, Features, Special Features, Legal Bases and privacy policy link, and make granular choices per Purpose and per Vendor?
Does the 2nd layer allow granular opt-in choices per Special Feature?
Are user choices set to 'off' by default? (screenshot as a first-time user)
If any Vendor uses legitimate interest, does the 2nd layer specify the nature of processed information and its scope?
If any Vendor uses legitimate interest, does the 2nd layer allow objection per Purpose and per Vendor?
Does the secondary layer show the number of Vendors seeking consent or relying on LI for each Purpose?
Does the secondary layer let users access Vendors' information about their legitimate interest at stake?
Does the secondary layer show Vendors' retention periods?
Does the secondary layer disclose the categories of data collected and/or held by Vendors?
If the 2nd layer uses modified or extra illustrations for Purposes, is the flag set to 1? (Purpose 1 and Special Purpose illustrations may not be modified)
Does the secondary layer disclose how the TC String is stored and the maximum device storage duration?
Can the user resurface the CMP UI easily (for apps, from the app's top-level settings)?
Can the user withdraw consent as easily as they gave it (a "withdraw all" equivalent to "accept all")?
